Implemented Axure-style canvas behavior with pure math in `canvas-math.ts` and wiring in the builder/canvas UI.

### Changed paths

**New**
- `src/studio/prototype/canvas-math.ts` — marquee hit-test, selection, groups, snap guides, nudge/resize, distances, zoom helpers, tool key map
- `src/studio/prototype/canvas-math.test.ts` — unit tests (9 cases)
- `src/studio/prototype/canvas-context-menu.tsx` — right-click menu with shortcuts

**Modified**
- `src/studio/prototype/builder.tsx` — marquee (⌥ = contain), ⌘/Shift-click, group/ungroup, lock/hide, snap grid toggles (⌘' / ⌘⌥'), pink guides + move tooltip, ⌥ distance lines, arrow nudge 1/10 px and ⌘+arrow resize, context menu, tools R/O/L/T/F/D/H/M and V select, `/` quick insert, zoom shortcuts, Space pan
- `src/studio/prototype/canvas.tsx` — grid overlay, marquee, guides, distances, tooltip, pan cursor, context menu hook
- `src/studio/prototype/model.ts` — optional `groupId` on elements
- `src/shared/i18n.ts` — context menu and quick-insert strings (en/ru)

`npx tsc --noEmit` and all **68** prototype tests pass.

Area «feature:office-studio-prototype»: earlier accepted tasks, newest first. Their decisions are in main; keep them unless this task changes them.
- 2026-10-17T17:43 prototype-calm-tiles: Prototype: borderless palette tiles, hover/selection highlight on palette and canvas. Palette tiles and canvas elements have no clutter frames; an element lights up on hover and clearly shows when it is selected.
- 2026-10-17T17:25 prototype-toolbar: Prototype: icon toolbar with groups, tooltips, align tools, zoom menu and primary Send. The prototype builder has a compact, friendly icon toolbar like Axure instead of a row of text buttons.
- 2026-10-17T17:17 prototype-inline-edit: Prototype: inline editing on double click, Enter adds the next item or radio. The owner renames elements by double click right on the canvas and builds radio groups and lists by pressing Enter.
- 2026-10-17T17:07 prototype-palette-previews: Prototype palette: tile grid with live element previews. The prototype palette shows each element as a small visual preview tile with its name, like Axure's library panel.
- 2026-10-17T16:19 prototype-builder: Office Studio prototype builder: canvas, UI elements with badges, save and send to chat. In Office Studio the owner builds a UI prototype from ready elements with name badges, saves it in the chat's files and sends a screenshot and/or the JSON to the chat for the agent.
Files of this area: src/studio/prototype/builder.tsx, src/shared/i18n.ts, src/studio/prototype/align.test.ts, src/studio/prototype/align.ts, src/studio/prototype/editing.test.ts, src/studio/prototype/editing.ts, src/studio/prototype/palette.test.ts, src/studio/prototype/palette.ts, server.ts, src/server/wireframes.ts, src/studio/prototype/elements.tsx, src/studio/prototype/model.test.ts, src/studio/prototype/model.ts, src/studio/tools.tsx

- `components/ui/icon-extended.tsx` and `components/ui/icon-registry.ts` register the builtin brand icon names `Figma`, `Notion`, `Slack`, `Telegram`, `Youtube`, `GoogleDoc` and `GoogleDrive`, alongside the existing names, which are unchanged. The test in `src/spreadsheet/link-chip.test.ts` checks against `EXTENDED_ICON_NAMES`.
- Invariant: picking a tool and the Back to tools action in the launcher work as before. The Prototype and Paint tools (`src/studio/prototype/` and `src/studio/paint/`) are not changed by launcher work.
- Execution defaults can pin a chat environment as `folder` or `worktree`. Resolve the pin nearest-first across section, ancestors, project, and global settings. A `worktree` pin preselects a managed worktree on the folder host in both New chat and the composer chip; spawn must preserve that managed-worktree selection. With no pin, keep the existing folder/section-provider behavior. Groups must never become chat environments.
